in_marathi.name: Kumaresh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumaresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ku means 'Lord' or 'God' in Sanskrit, Ma means 'Mother' or 'Goddess', and Rish means 'Ascetic' or 'Sage'. Kumaresh is a name of Lord Shiva, signifying the god who is the ruler of the universe and the protector of his devotees.

Kumaresh is a name of Lord Shiva, signifying the god who is the ruler of the universe and the protector of his devotees.
